# PART 1 – Credibility and the toolchain {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 1 – 90 minutes
:::

::: notes
Part one, then. A short opening on why any of this matters: the vocabulary that separates three kinds of repetition, and three very large studies that measured how often social-science findings survive being repeated, one of which supplies the case of today. Then the main business of the part, the toolchain, taken apart layer by layer: the language, the editor, the file formats, rendering, packages, version control, archives and licences. We finish on the two places where you will work today, the browser lab and the workspace, and on the setup check that gets your machine ready.
:::
